preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100) representing the number of test cases.
Each test case consists of exactly two lines: the first line is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 200), and the second line is a string a of length n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(test_case.split()[0]) <= 200 for test_case in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the integer n satisfies 1 ≤ n ≤ 200.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n for n, a in [(int(test_case.split()[0]), test_case.split()[1]) for test_case in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if test_case.split())
preconditions.description: For each test case, the string a has length exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in a) for n, a in [(int(test_case.split()[0]), test_case.split()[1]) for test_case in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if test_case.split())
preconditions.description: Each character in string a is a lowercase English letter.

postconditions.expression: all(len(b) == n for n, b in zip([int(test_case.split()[0]) for test_case in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string b has length exactly n.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(a) == sorted(b) for n, a, b in zip([int(test_case.split()[0]) for test_case in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [test_case.split()[1] for test_case in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string b is a permutation of the input string a.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(t == 'trygub' and all(t[i] in b and b.index(t[i]) > b.index(t[i-1]) for i in range(1, len(t))) for t in ['trygub'] for b in stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string b does not contain 'trygub' as a subsequence.
